description: Infeed to Distribution System Operators (DSO) networks (Near real-time) is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. This report contains the last available infeed data and is updated every 5 minutes (please refer to the Last processing time below for the timestamp). Last infeed measurements for the injection stations to the Belgian Distribution System Operators (DSO).All data published in this report are for information purposes only and are not legally binding. Coverage: Belgium. The portal files it under Balancing. Its keywords are Availibility, Near real-time. The portal shows 2024-10-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
